newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soy basis little changed.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soy basis little changed.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn, wheat and soybean basis values were little changed on Monday as movement along the Mississippi River slowly began to return to normal, export sources said.
"The crest is moving down south and dissipating. We are not anticipating any more closures, and by the end of the week things should be close to normal," one dealer said.
Earlier Monday the Coast Guard repealed most restrictions to maritime transport on the lower Mississippi River.
Trade was reported to be quiet.
